title: comparete pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

name.errorMessage: Genome name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fasta.errorMessage: Second column must be either a genome FASTA (.fa/.fasta/.fna, optionally gzipped) or an NCBI accession

gff.errorMessage: GFF file, when provided, must have extension .gff/.gff3 (optionally gzipped)
